product_findings.title: attestation_status='host_signed' is a plain label — consumers verify it NOT AT ALL
product_findings.mechanism: label set from a boolean at revenue_core.py:167 (attestation_status = 'host_signed' if attestation_capability() else 'unattested'); attestation_capability() at revenue_core.py:113-125 returns True if the REVENUE_ATTESTATION_PROVIDER path EXISTS AS A FILE (no key, no issuer, no signature, no provider invocation); consumption is set membership only at revenue_publication.py:222-226 (require(attestation in (None, 'host_signed', 'unattested'), ...)). No signature/issuer/publication_attestation check exists anywhere in scripts/.
product_findings.reviewer_new_material_finding: pointing REVENUE_ATTESTATION_PROVIDER at a 5-byte plain .txt yields attestation_capability() == True -> a FORMAL publication is stamped host_signed with NO signature or issuer field -> the strong dispatcher ACCEPTS it. Any operator can mint 'host-signed' artifacts with an env var aimed at a text file.
product_findings.also: the honest unmodified 'unattested' package is likewise accepted by every consumer entry point in this repo: consumers do not under-verify, they do not verify.
